sources.title: NFL Network’s Daniel Jeremiah has the Broncos selecting Georgia LB CJ Allen in his latest mock draft
sources.description: It’s that time of the year. The season is over, we’re talking free agents, and the NFL Scouting Combine will be here in less than a week. That means it is time to start looking at some mock drafts and see who some of the experts have the Denver Broncos taking in the first round […]
